name: Yowakute New Game
original_name: よわくてニューゲーム
source:
Under the cherry blossom tree, she said this.

"I'll kill you."

After being blackmailed by a murderous high school girl named Sanae Hoshina, he ends up creating a game.

However, all the games she suggests are disturbing...

[From [url=https://fuwadenken.itch.io/newgame]itch.io[/url]]
